fallbacks.title: Platform defaults for uncovered controls
fallbacks.statement: If the system defines no control for a need, use the platform's native element with the leader field styling; keep native semantics.
constraints: mark the improvisation and report a gap

exception.reason: Authored policy for needs the system does not cover: platform defaults with the recorded field styling, marked and reported as a gap. No source decision states this policy.
exception.basis: Synthesis protocol phase 5; field styling follows L-11.

fallbacks.title: Selection beyond small sets
fallbacks.statement: Small sets use a native select styled like a field; larger or filtered selection uses the platform default, marked.
constraints: report a gap if the need recurs

exception.reason: Restates decision L-12, which the Gate-2 review left undefined (LEAVE UNDEFINED); the historical pack shipped this fallback anyway. Recorded as authored policy pending an owner decision: endorse L-12 into the ledger, or convert this fallback into a case.
exception.basis: Synthesis protocol phase 5; lineage via L-12 (left undefined at Gate 2).

fallbacks.title: Interstitials become ruled panels
fallbacks.statement: No dialog canon: interstitials render as plain ruled panels in the page flow (L-07); mark the improvisation.

exception.reason: Authored policy for interstitials (wizard/onboarding): ruled panels in the page flow, marked and reported. No dialog canon was endorsed at Gate 2 (L-19 was left undefined), so the 'no dialog canon' premise stands; flagged for owner review.
